raw:
@q query
  where match
    relation "be responsible for"
    role subject ?c
    role object "Piedmont"
    polarity affirmed
  end
  compare ?c any
    ?c equal "the Romanian consulate in Milan"
    ?c equal "the Romanian consulate in Turin"
  end
